harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured a tagged-VLAN trunk over the shared eth1 physical link across node1/node2/node3: node1 (OpenWrt) hosts 802.1q sub-interfaces eth1.10 (192.168.10.1/24) and eth1.20 (192.168.20.1/24) with dedicated firewall zones (forward=REJECT, no cross-zone forwarding rule) providing routing and isolation; node2 joined VLAN 10 via nmcli VLAN connection (192.168.10.2/24, gw .1); node3 joined VLAN 20 via nmcli VLAN connection (192.168.20.2/24, gw .1). Verified each host reaches node1 on its own VLAN while node2↔node3 traffic is refused (ICMP net-unreachable from node1's forward-reject policy). Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes: captured baseline boot_id, restarted natively (reboot on OpenWrt, systemctl reboot on AlmaLinux), confirmed boot_id changed on each, and re-verified VLAN config persistence and connectivity/isolation after each restart.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 (OpenWrt 25.12.2) and node2/node3 (AlmaLinux 9.6) interfaces to identify eth1 as the shared trunk link separate from the eth0 management network
Created UCI 8021q device sections vlan10/vlan20 (eth1.10 vid 10, eth1.20 vid 20) and interfaces lan10 (192.168.10.1/24) / lan20 (192.168.20.1/24) on node1, committed and reloaded network
Created firewall zones zone_vlan10 and zone_vlan20 on node1 with forward=REJECT and no forwarding rule between them, committed and reloaded firewall
Configured node2 with an nmcli VLAN connection eth1.10 (vid 10) at 192.168.10.2/24, gateway 192.168.10.1, replacing the raw eth1 profile
Configured node3 with an nmcli VLAN connection eth1.20 (vid 20) at 192.168.20.2/24, gateway 192.168.20.1, replacing the raw eth1 profile
Verified node2->node1 and node3->node1 reachability, and confirmed node2<->node3 ping fails (isolated)
Captured pre-restart boot_id (/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id) on all three nodes as baseline
Restarted node1 via backgrounded 'sleep 1; reboot', polled until exec returned, confirmed changed boot_id, re-verified VLAN interfaces, IPs, and firewall zones persisted
Restarted node2 via 'systemctl reboot &', polled until exec returned, confirmed changed boot_id, re-verified VLAN10 config and connectivity/isolation
Restarted node3 via 'systemctl reboot &', polled until exec returned, confirmed changed boot_id, re-verified VLAN20 config and connectivity/isolation

evidence.requirement: node1 carries tagged VLANs 10 and 20 as router, each with its own subnet
evidence.summary: UCI config for eth1.10/eth1.20 8021q devices and lan10/lan20 static interfaces created, committed, reloaded; ip -4 addr shows eth1.10=192.168.10.1/24 and eth1.20=192.168.20.1/24 up

evidence.requirement: node2 is in VLAN10 own subnet and reaches node1
evidence.summary: nmcli VLAN connection vlan10 created (eth1.10, vid10, 192.168.10.2/24, gw .1); ping to 192.168.10.1 succeeds 0% loss

evidence.requirement: node3 is in VLAN20 own subnet and reaches node1
evidence.summary: nmcli VLAN connection vlan20 created (eth1.20, vid20, 192.168.20.2/24, gw .1); ping to 192.168.20.1 succeeds 0% loss

evidence.requirement: traffic between node2 and node3 is refused (VLAN isolation)
evidence.summary: Cross-VLAN pings (192.168.20.2 from node2, 192.168.10.2 from node3) fail 100% loss both before and after node restarts, confirmed by firewall zone forward=REJECT with no inter-zone forwarding rule

evidence.requirement: node1 restart evidence: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 1af5a6a1...; reboot acknowledged before disconnect (subsequent poll timed out confirming disconnection); post-restart boot_id d2e06cd3... (changed); VLAN IPs and firewall zones confirmed persisted via UCI

evidence.requirement: node2 restart evidence: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id f43afa1c...; systemctl reboot acknowledged; post-restart boot_id 7b9293ac... (changed); VLAN10 interface, gateway reachability, and cross-VLAN block reconfirmed

evidence.requirement: node3 restart evidence: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id dfdea52d...; systemctl reboot acknowledged; post-restart boot_id b2b8926d... (changed); VLAN20 interface, gateway reachability, and cross-VLAN block reconfirmed
